author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Frontal bat as one mirrored outline on HRECT_L: wing tips flaring up, deep concave top edges into the shoulders, two pointed ears with a flat head top, outer wing edges bulging to the full width, deep scallops ending in sharp points and a central bottom point. No Lucide bat; symmetric cubic construction.
omissions: Face (dot eyes and frown) omitted: the head between the shoulders is 14 wide, too narrow for 8-unit spacing around the eyes.
